C. I. D.
X. Q. REG
No. 624
Date 7/10/16

No
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

5th October 1916

Sir,
The troops were expecting to be paid to-day
but as the usual list of names has not been made
it would appear that payment has been postponed.

About 300 destitute rebels visited the office
for repatriation on the 4th inst and created a
disturbance. Some of them were almost naked.

It is reported that Moh Siang Yao 穆湘瑤,
a former Chief of Police, is negotiating for the
purchase of 60 mow of land off Lay Road and
proposes to build a silk filature there. He is
said to be acting on behalf of Liang Shih Yi.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
X. Q. 登记处
编号 624
日期 1916年10月7日

致
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年10月5日

先生：

部队原定于今日领饷，但由于尚未编制通常的姓名清单，看来发饷已被推迟。

本月4日，约300名贫困的反叛者前往办事处申请遣返，并制造了骚乱。其中一些人几乎赤身裸体。

据报，前警察局长穆湘瑤正在洽谈购买雷士德路（Lay Road）附近六十亩土地，并拟在此处建造一家缫丝厂。据说他是代表梁士诒行事。

您忠顺的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监上尉。
